description: This file defines the ApplicationInsightsClient class, which is a client for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights service. It includes method annotations for various API calls related to application management, components, log patterns, and workloads.

classes.name: ApplicationInsightsClient
classes.description: A client class for accessing Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights API, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: addWorkload
methods.description: Adds a workload to Application Insights.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application in Application Insights.
